title: Invertibility of the specified graph map on unbounded complexes
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $U,X$ locally Noetherian quasi-compact schemes, $f:U\to X$ separated etale, and $c$ a compactification. In particular $f$ is of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. The actual natural transformation $Da:Df_{\Sigma!}\to Rr_*Dj_!$ [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison] is an isomorphism. Its uniquely determined inverse defines canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison. Together with [lem-asd-compact-support-graph-sheaf-normalization] and the proved $Q_h$ component formula, it defines canonicalEtaleCompactSupportCore.

proof.text: For each geometric point g:Spec Ω→X, the pulled-back f_g is quasi-compact and locally quasi-finite. Since Spec Ω is locally Artinian, Mathlib AlgebraicGeometry.IsFinite.of_locallyQuasiFinite makes f_g finite. Apply [lem-asd-compact-support-finite-graph-isomorphism] to the base-changed compactification. This replaces the planned decomposition into field points, clopen-section geometry and separate K-injective evaluation theorem.

proof.text: Unbounded torsion proper base change for c.g makes the specified compact-support exchange at g an isomorphism. Evaluate [lem-asd-compact-support-graph-geometric-base-change] at K. Its right side is the sum-exchange isomorphism followed by the finite-fibre graph isomorphism. The left side is Dg*(a_K) followed by the compact-support exchange. Cancel the latter to prove Dg*(a_K) invertible.

proof.text: The canonical left-derived/exact inverse-image comparison identifies Dg*(a_K) with Lg*(a_K). Apply the established source-library theorem isIso_of_isIso_leftDerivedUpperStar_algClosurePoint_map, whose proof uses exact inverse image, conservative geometric points, and the unbounded cohomology isomorphism criterion. Every a_K is invertible; NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app gives invertibility of the natural transformation. No equality of derived maps is tested on stalks.

theorem isIso_compactSupportGraphDerivedComparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {U X : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ X) [Etale f] [IsSeparated f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian U] [CompactSpace U] [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    (c : Compactification f) :
    IsIso (compactSupportDerivedComparison A f c
      (etaleCompactificationGraphMap A f c))
